summary: Generated and visually inspected one monochrome orthographic 2.5D open-basin world-map concept containing one main continent, one rugged island, and two mostly low city-suitable islands, with no cities or built structures.

generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game world geography mockup
Primary request: Create a complete terrain-only fantasy world map with exactly four landmasses total: one single connected main continent and exactly three detached islands. The broad asymmetric continent is organized around a large open river basin, with mountain ranges pushed toward its northern and western edges. Preserve three very widely separated broad lowland regions across the continent in a wide triangular arrangement; each region must have generous uninterrupted flat expansion room suitable for a future sprawling capital, but all terrain is presently unoccupied.
Scene/backdrop: dark open ocean completely surrounds every landmass, with clear uninterrupted water gaps between them and a generous ocean margin around the entire composition.
Subject/geography: The main continent has varied natural coasts, broad plains, foothills, uplands, and distinct readable elevation bands. Island 1 is rugged, mountainous, dramatic, and intentionally unoccupied. Island 2 is a long low harbor island with at least 65 percent broad flat or gently rolling buildable terrain and a sheltered natural bay. Island 3 is a compact low cove island with at least 65 percent broad flat or gently rolling buildable terrain and a protected cove. Space all three islands well away from the continent and from each other. Do not add any other islands, islets, offshore rocks, sea stacks, sandbars, or cropped land at the frame edges.
Hydrology: Show several continuous connected mountain-fed rivers descending from the northern and western ranges into the open basin, feeding one visible lake or wetland system, then continuing through distributaries to one or more coastal deltas. Rivers must visibly connect source to basin to sea.
Style/medium: orthographic 2.5D isometric terrain relief, monochrome technical realism, highly detailed engraved or finely modeled topography, believable geographic erosion, designed as a polished game-world planning map.
Composition/framing: wide landscape map; high oblique orthographic view with minimal perspective distortion; full map visible at once; sprawling low-density land arrangement with abundant breathing room for later zoom-in buildings and details.
Lighting/mood: soft raking neutral light that makes relief and elevation bands legible without hiding plains in shadow.
Color palette: restrained monochrome charcoal, graphite, slate gray, and pale stone; dark ocean; no accent colors.
Constraints: exactly one connected main continent and exactly three detached islands; three large separated empty lowland future-capital regions on the continent; exactly one rugged island and exactly two mostly low buildable islands; full coastline of all four landmasses visible; terrain and water only.
Avoid: cities, settlements, buildings, roads, paths, pads, walls, bridges, docks, ports, vehicles, farms, fields, labels, text, symbols, UI, compass rose, border, logo, grid, watermark, decorative ships, clouds, extra landmasses, extra islands, cropped land.

tests_run.details: Inspected the saved PNG at original resolution after copying it into the project.
Valid PNG signature; 1536 by 1024 pixels; 3301694 bytes.

claims.claim: The map has one visually connected main continent and exactly three clearly detached macro islands.
claims.evidence: Original-resolution visual inspection shows four separated macro landmasses with open-ocean gaps: the main continent, one rugged northeastern island, one elongated low southeastern harbor island, and one compact low southern cove island.

claims.claim: One island is rugged and unoccupied, while two islands provide broad low terrain suitable for future sprawling cities.
claims.evidence: The northeastern island is mountain-dominant; the southeastern and southern islands are predominantly flat or gently rolling and each contains a protected inward-curving coast. No structures are visible.

claims.claim: The continent supports three widely separated future capital regions with expansion room.
claims.evidence: Three large empty lowland plains are visibly separated in a broad triangular arrangement across the east, southeast, and southwest portions of the continent.

claims.claim: The terrain includes connected mountain-fed rivers, a wetland or lake-like basin, deltas, varied coasts, broad plains, and readable elevation bands.
claims.evidence: Multiple visible tributaries descend from the northern and western ranges into a central open wetland basin, continue south through a trunk channel, and spread into a coastal distributary delta; plains, foothills, mountains, cliffs, coves, and irregular coasts are legible.

claims.claim: The full map uses monochrome orthographic 2.5D technical-realism terrain presentation with ocean margin.
claims.evidence: The saved image is a wide high-oblique relief view in graphite, slate, pale-stone, and dark-ocean tones; every coastline is visible with surrounding water.

claims.claim: No prohibited built, textual, or interface elements are present.
claims.evidence: Visual inspection found no cities, buildings, roads, pads, docks, vehicles, labels, text, UI, logo, grid, or watermark.

risks_blockers: The 65 percent low-terrain threshold and exact land connectivity are visual judgments from the raster mockup rather than GIS measurements; both low islands visibly clear the intended planning threshold, and the macro landmass count is unambiguous.
